title: Transfer out form reject kyun hota hai?

brief.topic: Transfer out form (Form 13) reject kyun hota hai, aur kaise theek karein?

repeat_check.different_because: ep01 is about withdrawal claims (Form 19) getting rejected; this reel is about transfer claims (Form 13) getting rejected when changing jobs — different form, different reasons (exit date, Annexure K, two UANs, exempted trust).

brief.viewer: Someone who changed jobs, filed a transfer claim (Form 13) for the old PF, and whose money still hasn't moved to the new account.
brief.hook: Nayi naukri join kar li — purana PF aaya nahi?
brief.problem: The transfer claim comes back or sits for months, so the old PF stays in the old account and the old service doesn't join the new one.
why: The two jobs' service periods overlap in EPFO's records — EPFO itself says regional offices have been rejecting transfer claims for this.
The member's identity or account ownership couldn't be confirmed online, so the claim goes to the employer to forward after confirming identity.
The pension amount never moves with a transfer — only the past service history does — so a passbook without the pension amount looks like a failed transfer.
steps: Check the service dates: the old exit date against the new joining date — if they overlap, that is what EPFO's offices have been rejecting claims for.
If the identity couldn't be confirmed online, ask the employer to confirm the identity and forward the application — the Scheme says the employer shall do that.
If the employer won't attest or isn't available, get the form attested by the bank manager and submit it to the Regional PF Commissioner.
Check the transfer with Annexure K — the transfer certificate with the full details.
brief.check: Before filing again, check one thing: do the old exit date and the new joining date overlap in EPFO's records?
brief.help: The Regional PF Commissioner — EPFO's FAQ says the RPFC pursues the matter with the employer where attestation is disputed.
brief.share_target: A friend who changed jobs and whose old PF hasn't moved yet.
brief.why_now: Since January 2025 most transfer claims no longer need the employer at all, and since April 2025 the destination office's approval is gone too — so if yours is still stuck, it is one of these reasons.

data.label: Transfer claims expected to go direct to EPFO without employer intervention
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 19 January 2025: EPFO simplifies PF transfer process
data.check_note: Quote: 'it is expected that in future over 1.20 crore out of 1.30 crore total transfer claims i.e. 94% of the total claims would be directly forwarded to EPFO without requiring the employer's intervention.' Same release: the requirement to route online transfer claims through either employer 'has been removed in majority of cases'.
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Share of total grievances that are transfer-related
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 19 January 2025: EPFO simplifies PF transfer process
data.check_note: Quote: '(presently 17% of the total grievances pertain to transfer related issues) along with the corresponding rejections.'
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Transfer on changing jobs goes through the designated portal
data.statement: On changing jobs, a member may apply on the designated portal to transfer the PF balance from the old account to the new one.
data.source: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraph 43(1) (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Para 43, 'Transfer of membership', pp. 85-86: where a member relinquishes employment and secures employment in another establishment to which the Scheme applies, an exempted establishment, or an establishment with its own PF scheme, 'the member may apply on the designated portal, for the purpose for transfer of balance of the provident fund from the existing account to the new account.'
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: If identity can't be confirmed online, the employer forwards the transfer application
data.statement: If the member's identity or account ownership can't be confirmed online, the employer shall forward the transfer application after confirming the identity of the member.
data.source: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraph 43(3), proviso (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Para 43(3), pp. 85-86: 'Provided that in case of non-confirmation of the identity of the member of the provident fund account through online mode, the employer shall forward the application for transfer after confirming the identity of the member to the Commissioner.'
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Employer must upload leavers' details within 15 days of month close
data.statement: Every employer shall, within fifteen days of the close of each month, upload on the designated portal the details of the employees leaving service during the preceding month.
data.source: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraph 24(2)(v) (Gazette of India, G.S.R. 525(E), 29 June 2026)
data.check_note: Para 24(2), 'Duties of employers', pp. 78-79: 'Every employer shall, within fifteen days of the close of each month, upload electronically on the designated portal details of the employees leaving the service of the employer during the preceding month.' Sub-para (ii) covers joiners on transfer 'by way of linkage of UANs'.
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Overlap in service periods is not a disqualification for transfer
data.statement: Transfer claims have been rejected for overlap in service periods, but overlap can occur for genuine reasons and is not a disqualification per se; the source office must process the claim even with overlapping services, clarifying only where genuinely needed.
data.source: EPFO circular No. WSU/TransferClaim/E-52972/2025-26/07 dated 20/05/2025, 'Simplification of Transfer Claim Process — Handling of Overlapping Service Period during processing of Transfer Claim requests'
data.check_note: Quote: 'It has been observed that Transfer Claim requests are being rejected due to the issue of Overlap in Service Periods by the Regional Offices. However, overlapping in services can occur due to genuine reasons and therefore the same should not be considered to be a disqualification per-se in effecting transfers.' And: 'the Transfer Claim requests are required to be processed by the Transferor (Source) Office even though there may be overlapping services without returning or rejecting the same. Only in cases where a genuine need is felt to clarify the overlapping of service, would the claims be processed after obtaining the requisite clarification.' One-page circular, signed G.R. Suchindranath, ACC (WSU), with CPFC approval.
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Attestation is the employer's duty; bank attestation is the fallback
data.statement: It is the employer's duty to attest the application form; if the employer won't, the member may get attestation from the bank where they hold their account and submit to the Regional PF Commissioner, who will pursue the matter with the employer.
data.source: EPFO FAQ, Employer category (epfo.gov.in/faq-epfo/, last updated 6 November 2026)
data.check_note: FAQ: 'It is the duty of the employer to attest the application form. In case of any dispute, the member may attain attestation preferably from the bank in which he has maintained his account and thereafter submit the same to Regional PF Commissioner, explaining the reasons for not obtaining the signature of the employer. The Regional P.F. Commissioner will pursue the matter with the employer wherever necessary.' A second FAQ adds the bank manager route where the employer is not available or the establishment has closed.
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Only Form 19, 10C and 31 can be filed without employer attestation
data.statement: Currently a member can submit only three types of claims without attestation of the employer — Form 19, Form 10C and Form 31. Transfer (Form 13) is not among them.
data.source: EPFO FAQ, Employer category (epfo.gov.in/faq-epfo/, last updated 6 November 2026)
data.check_note: FAQ: 'Currently the member can submit 3 types of claims without attestation of Employer namely, Form-19, 10C and 31. However, the member must ensure that his UAN is activated and at least the bank account and Aadhaar KYC's in respect of his account are approved by the Employer using his Digital Signature Certificate.' Transfer is not listed.
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Pension amount is not transferred; only service history moves
data.statement: The pension amount is not transferred when employment changes; only the past service history moves, which makes the member eligible for pension benefits.
data.source: EPFO FAQ, Pensioner category (epfo.gov.in/faq-epfo/, last updated 6 November 2026)
data.check_note: FAQ: 'The pensionary benefits are dependent on the length of service and the average of last wages drawn. It does not depend on the actual amount lying in the Pension Fund Account. Hence this amount is not transferred during change of employment and a mere transfer of past service history makes the member eligible for pension related benefits.'
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Annexure K is the transfer certificate with full details
data.statement: Annexure-K is the transfer certificate giving full details of the transfer, issued to the transferee Regional PF Commissioner or PF Trust; a copy can be requested from the EPF office.
data.source: EPFO FAQ, Employee category (epfo.gov.in/faq-epfo/, last updated 6 November 2026)
data.check_note: FAQ: 'A copy of Transfer Certificate Annexure-K issued to the transferee Regional P.F. Commissioner/P.F. Trust giving full details of the transfer can be requested from the EPF office.'
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Different dates of exit can be entered for EPF and EPS
data.statement: Different dates of exit can be entered for EPF and EPS using Mark Exit; the EPS exit date cannot be later than the EPF exit date, and for an EPS member under 58 both must be the same.
data.source: EPFO FAQ, Pensioner category (epfo.gov.in/faq-epfo/, last updated 6 November 2026)
data.check_note: FAQ: 'It is possible to different Date of Exist for EPF and EPS, Please note that the date of exit form EPS may be blank if member is not an EPS member. It can be also earlier that date of exit PF only when the member has completed 58 years age. But it cannot be later than the exit form PF. For an EPS member not completed 58 years the date of exit in both has to be same.' Typos as on the page.
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

data.label: Destination office approval removed under revamped Form 13
data.statement: EPFO removed the requirement of approval of transfer claims at the destination office under the revamped Form 13; once the claim is approved at the source office, the previous account transfers automatically to the present account.
data.source: PIB, Ministry of Labour and Employment, 25 April 2025: Simplification of Transfer Claim Process through Revamped Form 13 functionality
data.check_note: Quote: 'EPFO has removed the requirement of approval of all transfer claims at the Destination Office by launching a Revamped Form 13 software functionality.' And: 'once the transfer claim gets approved at the Transferor (Source) Office the previous account will automatically get transferred to the present account of the member at the Transferee (Destination) Office instantly.'
data.check_result: Checked by Divyank on EPFO/PIB source

post.caption:
Naukri badli aur purana PF abhi tak naye account mein nahi aaya? Transfer claim (Form 13) aksar service period overlap ya online identity confirm na hone se atakta hai — aur pension ka paisa to transfer hota hi nahi. Reel mein EPFO ke rules se aaye steps hain. Apni exit date aur joining date pehle check karo, phir dobara file karo. EPFO ki har jankari chahiye? Follow karo @pfguruji. PF Guru Ji EPFO ka official channel nahi hai. Niyam: epfo.gov.in
